conclusion: redteam_diagnostic() takes no arguments, performs no I/O, and calls no external authorization or validation function. `rejected` is definitionally `mask != 0`, and by the function's own corpus-generation construction (singleton bits, pairwise bits, then ascending masks filtered to popcount>=3) every generated mask is provably non-zero, so `all_rejected` is true for any run regardless of external system state. `granted` is the single hardcoded literal `false`, never assigned from `mask`, `index`, or any other value, so `authority_granted_count` is definitionally 0 on every run. Both quantities that gate `passed` for this module's own diagnostic entry are therefore invariant constants, not measurements.
